## 👋 About Me

I'm an **IT Manager** with **10+ years of experience** in information technology and a background in **Computer Programming**. I manage IT infrastructure, systems and databases, and I use **AI tools to automate processes**, speed up development and turn data into actionable reports. My focus is building practical, reliable and efficient solutions that save teams time.

> 🇹🇷 **Hakkımda:** Bilgisayar Programcılığı mezunu, 10+ yıl tecrübeli bir BT Yöneticisiyim. BT altyapısı, sistem ve veritabanı yönetiminin yanı sıra yapay zeka araçlarıyla süreç otomasyonu, AI destekli yazılım geliştirme ve veri analizi üzerine çalışıyorum.

## 🚀 What I Do

- ⚙️ **AI-Powered Process Automation** — Automating repetitive IT and business workflows with AI
- 🤖 **AI-Assisted Development** — Building scripts and applications with Claude Code, Copilot and ChatGPT
- 📊 **Data Analysis & Reporting** — Turning data into insights with SQL, Python and AI

## 🧩 Core Competencies
